profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Amex
profile.summary:
Passionate software developer specializing in mobile applications, with background in Dart/Flutter, Swift and Kotlin as well as previous experience in Java development and Big Data.

Experienced in working with cross-functional teams and adhering to agile methodologies. Proactive problem solver, dedicated to staying current with industry trends and sharing knowledge. Let's connect and discuss how I can contribute to your team's goals

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Skills: Analytical Skills · Programming · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) · Java

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Responsible for leading recitation sessions and developing communication strategies for student comprehension. 
•	Prepared and led review sessions covering integral course topics to a large group of students in a conference setting.
•	Solidified personal foundation of core topics and acquired better communication skills by presenting ideas to groups of students.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Redesigned legacy code responsible with validation and ingestion of data bus messages regarding customer transactions to be further analyzed for lending risk
•	Researched and compiled validation metrics necessary for verification and risk decision analysis, reducing the percentage of error that reached critical procedures by 75 percent
•	Designed custom validations for seven different uses cases in incoming messages from bus
•	Performed regression and performance testing and captured results for further documentation
•	Contributed to development of microservice in the risk decision team in a CI/DC environment
•	Redesign reached latest test environment and is in line to reach production

positions.title: Product Development Intern
positions.description:
• Researched current market tools, and presented to stakeholders with a design and plan of action for data quality
• Designed and Developed proof of concept of data quality tool in an agile environment using big data tools such as Databricks and Azure Blob storage

educations.schoolName: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering at Arizona State University
